purpose: Known-undispatched XCTest failures cannot be converted to successful taps by an unrelated changed capture.
boundary: Real daemon interaction dispatcher with mocked native execution boundary and actual same-scope capture corroboration. Not native-device fault injection.

beforeFix.knownNoCase: failed: dispatcher returned success despite explicit dispatched:no

afterFix.cases: Omitted/unknown delivery retain existing corroboration; known no-dispatch preserves typed failure, zero action history and zero corroboration captures.

qualification: The before-fix focused run preceded the additional unknown-delivery row and the final short test name; no claim that the complete before/after suites were identical.
